subject: general
question: The number of players in baseball is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**9 players**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **9 players** are on a baseball team on the field at any one time.
 
• Each team has positions including pitcher, catcher, four infielders (first baseman, second baseman, shortstop, third baseman), and three outfielders (left fielder, center fielder, right fielder).
 
• Baseball is a bat-and-ball game played between two opposing teams who take turns batting and fielding.
 
• The game has no fixed time limit; it ends when one team has scored more runs than the other after nine innings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Baseball** is widely considered the national pastime of the United States.
 
• The sport has a long history, with its origins traced back to the 18th century.
 
• Major League Baseball (MLB) is the professional baseball organization and the oldest of the major professional sports leagues in the United States and Canada.
 
• The first professional baseball team was the Cincinnati Red Stockings, established in 1869.
 
• In baseball, the team that scores the most runs in a game wins.
